[ from kalusa; S. kāluṣya], dirtiness; obscuration; opacity ; Sv 275, 19 (cittassa ~-bhāvo, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee kalusabhāvo) = Ps III 368, 21 ( Be, Se kālussiyabhāvo; Ce, Ee kalusa-); — ifc see kilesa-, cakkhu-, citta- ( sv citta 1 ), disā-; — akālusiya , akālussiya, n. , freedom from dirtiness and opacity; clearness ; — ~-paccupaṭṭhāna, mfn. , manifested as freedom from dirt or obscuration ; Pj II 144, 5 (saddhā okappanalakkhaṇā … ~-paccupaṭṭhānā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se akālussiya-) = As 120, 18 ( Be, Ce so; Ee, Se akālussiya-).
